info.name: SPACZ Platform API
info.description:
All calls go through the API gateway ({{baseUrl}}, default http://localhost:8080).

Run the folders top to bottom (Collection Runner works): each request stores tokens and IDs in collection variables for the next ones. Set adminEmail / adminPassword to the BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_* values from .env. The phone-OTP requests need OTP_EXPOSE_CODE=true (development) so the code comes back in the response.

exec: const d = n => { const x = new Date(); x.setUTCDate(x.getUTCDate() + n); return x.toISOString().slice(0, 10); };
pm.test("Vendor: request phone OTP: HTTP 202", () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));

request.description: The code is in the response only with OTP_EXPOSE_CODE=true; otherwise read it from the auth-service log.

exec: pm.test("Vendor: verify unknown number → 422 REGISTRATION_REQUIRED: HTTP 422", () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));

item.name: Vendor: verify with role → registered and logged in

exec: pm.test("Vendor: verify with role → registered and logged in: HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Refresh (rotates the refresh token): HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Submit vendor for approval: HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
